author: official
summary: Lets an owner change the words of a plain heading, paragraph or list item in a framed preview; posts a text-only edit to the host.

attributes.name: data-dynamic-coral
attributes.description: Selects the text-edit coral. One per page.

attributes.name: data-parent-origin
attributes.description: The only origin edits are posted to and answers are accepted from (answers must also come from the parent window itself). One http(s) origin written as the origin, a trailing slash allowed; `*`, `null`, paths and other spellings are refused. No default: the coral does not mount without it.

attributes.name: data-revision
attributes.description: The source revision the page was rendered from (text-edit-source.mjs `sourceRevision`). Every edit carries it and the applier refuses any other; a successful answer carries the next one. No default: the coral does not mount without it.

attributes.name: data-page
attributes.description: The page path the host saves to. Absent: the frame's location.pathname.

attributes.name: data-hint-editor
attributes.description: The host's sentence for text that has formatting or structure (use the editor).

attributes.name: data-hint-refused
attributes.description: The host's sentence for a refused edit, when its answer carries none.

attributes.name: data-hint-unknown
attributes.description: The host's sentence for an edit whose answer did not come in time (its words are not confirmed, and the coral is reading them back).

requirements: Renderer output inside a frame, rendered with source spans (`parseSite(md, { sourceLines: true })`, or `SITETILE_SOURCE_SPANS=1` for the Astro build) so editable elements carry `data-src`; elements without it are not offered. Only `prose` sections (the renderer's `section.st-prose[id]`) are offered; every other section's text is component text and stays untouchable. The host stamps `data-revision` from the Markdown it rendered, applies edits with text-edit-source.mjs (or a port measured against it), and answers with `reef-text-edit-result`, echoing the message's `doc` (the coral ignores an answer with any other `doc`, or none) and relaying `revision` and `section` from a successful apply. It processes the frame's messages in the order received, one at a time, and answers a `reef-text-edit-readback` with `reef-text-edit-readback-result` (same `doc`) (text-edit-source.mjs `readTextAt`). It answers a host's `reef-text-edit-probe` (`nonce`) from the parent origin with its ready, `{ type: 'reef-text-edit-ready', doc, probe: nonce }` (1.1.0). Served by the coral registry on channel `v1` (`/corals/text-edit/v1/text-edit.js`; the host must echo `doc`; text-edit has never been published on `v0`): the host adds the mount and the script to its own framed preview.
